seo_title: Virtual Wallet & Gift Card API Integration for SMEs
seo_desc: Can't your customers use their online gift cards in your physical store? We integrate cloud virtual wallet APIs for B2C and B2B SMEs and local businesses.
author_pitch: I have seen local businesses and clinics lose thousands of euros in advance sales because they couldn't issue digital gift cards compatible with their physical store. I build cloud bridges so your systems speak the same language and your cash flow grows without technological barriers.
title: Gift Card and Virtual Wallet API: Unify Your Physical and Online Balance
body:
Do you lose sales because the gift cards from your website do not work at your physical store's checkout?

For small businesses, clinics, and local stores, selling gift cards or prepaid vouchers is a vital cash injection. However, the major bottleneck arises when you try to make the balance purchased on your e-commerce recognized by your physical POS. Managing these balances manually in spreadsheets or notebooks generates accounting discrepancies, customer frustration, and financial losses due to fraud or human error.

The trap of Isolated E-commerce Plugins

Installing a basic gift card module in WordPress or Shopify only works on the internet, leaving your physical store completely blind. A fragmented sales ecosystem destroys the shopping experience of your best customers.

Our solution: Omnichannel Virtual Wallet Cloud API

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we connect your points of sale using a Serverless Cloud API. We create a centralized virtual wallet that acts as an "in-house bank" for your business. When a customer buys an online voucher, the API updates the central database in real-time, allowing that QR code or locator to be scanned and deducted at your physical counter instantly, and vice versa.

  1. Real Bidirectional Synchronization: We connect your Point of Sale (POS) software with your online store so that the customer's balance is identical and instantly updated across both channels.
  2. Secure Digital Wallets: We implement Cloud technology so your customers can store their gift cards directly in Apple Wallet or Google Pay via a simple link.
  3. Anti-Fraud API Validation: We generate single-use cryptographic tokens to prevent the same gift code from being photocopied or redeemed twice by mistake at your location.
  4. Cloud Accounting Traceability: We integrate a centralized dashboard where your accounting firm can automatically export liabilities and consumed balances to comply with tax regulations without headaches.

The Real Impact on Your Small Business

  • Direct cash flow injection: Multiply your advance sales revenue and Christmas campaigns by offering digital gift cards without technical friction.
  • Absolute customer loyalty: Allow users to spend their refunds or store credit both online and in person, drastically improving their satisfaction.
  • Zero cash register discrepancies: Eliminate notebooks and manual Excel files forever; the cloud mathematically balances the exact cents consumed from each voucher for you.
